description: START HERE: Start a personal assistant session for Alex, synthesize a briefing from fixture artifacts, and inspect the durable session brief.

annotations.text: First run from the repo root: `agentic run examples/personal-assistant`. Add `--harness pi` only when you want Pi to execute the prepared turn.
What this demonstrates: durable profile + policy + continuity + recent sessions + open loops -> session-start workflow -> durable briefing -> concise next-step decision.
